notes: Evaluated on a stratified sample (stratified on label) of 500 of the 1,367 images in the train split (36.6%, seed=42); every model is scored on the identical subset, so results are comparable across models on this dataset but are an estimate of full-split performance. gemma classification prompt: 'Classify the image into exactly one of the following categories: European beech, European silver fir, Norway spruce, Sessile oak. Respond with a JSON object containing a single key "label" whose value is the single best-matching category name, exactly as written above (one of: European beech, European silver fir, Norway spruce, Sessile oak), and nothing else.'. Generation sampling params (vLLM): {'temperature': 1.0, 'top_p': 0.95, 'top_k': 64}, max_tokens=256, batch_size=32. Chat template kwargs: {}. Predicted labels are extracted from a JSON {"label": ...} response and matched to the dataset's category names by exact string match only (see parse_predicted_label); samples with no exact match are excluded from metrics (see metrics['skipped_samples']). f1/precision/recall are macro-averaged multiclass metrics (see compute_classification_metrics).
